subject: Re: Infra hiring — Senior/Staff Runtime engineer headcount and offer approval
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Req: Senior Infra Engineer (Runtime) — headcount & band request

Evelyn / Laura —

Quick note to request headcount approval to hire a Senior/Staff runtime engineer focused on serving/runtime optimizations (KV cache, batching, kernel tuning). Team has a clear blocker: the new quantized LLM pipeline increases token pressure and we need a dedicated hire to stabilize p99 latency and finish the kernel offload work.

Role: Runtime / Inference Infrastructure engineer
Level: hiring manager requests IC4/IC5 (Senior or Staff, flexible depending on candidate)
Suggested start: target onboarding 2026-05-01
Justification: shipping critical throughput improvements for Dedicated customers; several customer escalations tied to latency degradation under burst workloads.
Budget ask: propose comp band aligned to infra IC4-IC5 — rough guidance: base 185k–210k, target total comp 230k–300k depending on level and equity. Open to approve up to 275k total comp at upper bound if candidate has distributed systems + high-performance inference experience.

Please advise on band confirmation and whether we can convert an open headcount from Q2 hiring plan (infra pool) to this req. Attaching the JD in a follow-up.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Req: Senior Infra Engineer (Runtime) — headcount & band request

Marcus —

Thanks for the write-up, this aligns with the infra priorities we discussed on the Q2 planning call. A few asks before I loop in TalentBridge to extend an offer:

- Confirm the preferred level (IC4 vs IC5) and the minimum acceptable total comp if we need to move quickly.
- Confirm which open headcount slot you want to use (infra pool vs platform dedicated slot).
- If we anticipate needing to go above the usual band, please put candidate-specific rationale here so I can expedite.

I'll need signoff from Laura (People Ops) for the comp band and from Markus for team budget. Please reply with the level preference; I'll hold off contacting the recruiter until we have numbers.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart

Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Req: Senior Infra Engineer (Runtime) — headcount & band request

Evelyn / Marcus —

Reviewed the request and the Q2 hiring plan. People Ops + Finance are comfortable approving this hire from the infra pool. A few specifics:

- Recommended level: IC5 (Staff) if candidate has explicit latency/tensor-kernel experience; otherwise IC4 (Senior).
- Comp guidance (US - San Francisco market): base $185,000–$210,000; target total cash + equity (on-target) $240,000–$290,000.
- We can approve an offer up to $300,000 total comp only with explicit director signoff (Markus) and justification; please provide candidate comparisons if you expect to hit that ceiling.
- Headcount: we will convert one infra pool slot (Q2) to a filled req for your team; this counts against the platform hiring plan.

Attached: salary_grid_2026.xlsx for precise banding. For offers, People Ops prefers we make an initial ask at the band midpoint and leave room for negotiation. If Marcus and Markus confirm level and exact offer number, I can generate an offer letter and equity template.

Logging approval: People Ops approves the headcount conversion and the comp band limits above. Please obtain Markus' final signoff if you plan to exceed $290k total comp.

Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: salary_grid_2026.xlsx

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@talentbridge.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Offer instructions — Carlos Santos (Runtime candidate)

Sarah —

We'd like TalentBridge to extend an offer to Carlos Santos (intro from your team). Below are the specifics to include in the initial offer package:

- Role: Staff Runtime / Inference Infrastructure Engineer (IC5)
- Start: flexible, target 2026-05-01
- Initial offer: base $195,000; target total comp $260,000 (base + equity + expected bonus). This is midpoint-friendly and leaves negotiation room per Laura's guidance.
- Equity: 0.45% RSU vests over 4 years (subject to standard plan language) — include standard equity template.
- Signing bonus: none anticipated unless candidate has competing counteroffer; leave room to add up to $10k discretionary signing bonus pending Markus signoff.
- Contingencies: standard background and reference checks.

Please use the attached offer_template.pdf and JD_runtime_infra.md when building the package. Copy me on the outbound offer email. If salary negotiations exceed $290k total comp, pause and loop in Laura and Markus for final signoff.

Thanks — please confirm ETA to send offer.

Evelyn Hart
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Forwarded message: see thread above.
